prompt:
For the line "This strap sits right on that spot and takes the weight off.": A clean 3D medical anatomy model of the right knee on a pale grey seamless background, in natural tissue colours — red muscle, white tendons and ligaments, ivory bone — soft even light, textbook clarity. Image 1 is the strap, Image 2 it worn. Image 3 sets the light only.
Close-up from a low three-quarter angle, sharp on the strap: the strap of Image 1 copied exactly — a black shell, two pointed peaks round a notch, a chrome slide at each end — 12 × 5 cm, a third of the frame wide, its pad pressed on the white patellar tendon just under the kneecap, the kneecap's lower edge in its notch; under the pad the last of a red glow fading into a calm soft blue spreading along the tendon. Scale: the kneecap the width of the shell.
In frame: the knee model, the strap; every other area plain grey.
A final frame from a 3D animated feature film, stylized storybook render. The strap alone in real materials, in the same light. No lettering, logos or labels but its wordmark.
script_line: This strap sits right on that spot and takes the weight off.
